hints.content: The volume of a cylinder is the area of the base $\times$ height.
The area of a circle is $\pi r^2$.
So the area of the base is $\pi \cdot 3^2 = 9 \pi$.
The height of the cylinder is $8$, so the volume is $9\pi \cdot 8 = 72\pi$ cubic units.
